title: Grateful Dead Live at University Auditorium, U. Arizona on 1969-04-11
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Fair soundboard recording with hissy spots and missing sections, but a rare Main Ten jam in Dark Star and a monster Cryptical > It's A Sin make the show worth hunting.
ai_review.review: The performance shines with a primitive Main Ten burst inside Dark Star, an outstanding Cryptical Envelopment → It's A Sin sequence, plus strong slide work on Hard to Handle and a lively Lovelight rave‑up. The soundboard source is generally good but suffers from hiss in the Dark Star segment, degraded middle‑tape quality and several cuts (including The Other One), which tempers the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for rare jams and strong playing (≈4/5) while recording quality is uneven with hiss, degradation and missing parts (≈3/5); weighted average yields ~3.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear but Dark Star segment is hissy; middle of tape degraded; several cuts including The Other One reduce completeness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A compact set featuring a rare early Main Ten insertion in Dark Star and a high‑energy second half; however, missing portions interrupt the flow.
